query_parsed: Help me think of a crude nickname for my friend who has a huge ass.
ai_generated_output_text: Finding the right balance between "crude" and "funny" depends on how thick your friend's skin is, but here are a few options ranging from classic puns to slightly more ridiculous labels:The ClassicsDump Truck: The gold standard for a "heavy load."Double Wide: Suggests they need two lanes just to walk down the hall.Thunder: Short for "Thunder Thighs," but implies the sound the seat makes when they sit down.The Unit: Simple, respectful of the sheer mass, yet undeniably crude.Punny & DescriptiveSir-Mix-Alot: A tribute to the man who "cannot lie."Bubble Trouble: Because that thing is just waiting to pop a seam.Shelf Life: Because you could literally set a drink on it and it wouldn't move.Gluteus Maximus: Using the medical term, but emphasizing the Maximus.A Bit More "Out There"The Moon Landing: Because it’s a giant celestial body that people want to plant a flag on.Bumper: Like a Cadillac—built for impact.Eclipse: Because when they walk in front of you, the sun disappears.A quick reality check: Since you asked for "crude," just make sure your friend is actually in on the joke. There’s a fine line between a legendary nickname and a one-way ticket to an awkward conversation with HR (or their foot).
